Lina Park: Heads-up: we're getting subtle authz mismatches when requests cross hosted -> dedicated -> private. Can we agree a single minimal envelope?
Ben Huang: +1. multiple headers are the root cause. propose one compact header.
Ivy Patel: what fields are minimal? tenant, caller, ttl, flags, assertion id. keep payload tiny.
Tom Novak: private deployments require local verification via customer KMS. that implies an adapter that can translate/verify at the edge.
Lina Park: sketch: header X-RW-Assertion with base64 JSON payload + sig-meta. e.g. v=1;alg=hs1;pl=BASE64;sig=HEX.
Ben Huang: runtime behavior on unverifiable sigs? reject by default. allow tenant-config to enable adapter translation or platform-accept fallback.
Ivy Patel: TTL short (30s-2m). use HMAC for hot-path verification. adapters that use KMS sign with PK mode.
Tom Novak: critical: adapter translation MUST NOT escalate privileges. define a mapping table of allowed transforms and forbid dropping flags like "no-log" or setting "is_admin".
Lina Park: observability: always emit aid (assertion id) and truncated hash into traces. adapters must emit an audit event mapping orig_aid -> new_aid when they re-sign.
Ben Huang: I'll prototype a tiny Go verifier lib and a Node shim for adapters. API minimal: Verify([]byte) -> (payload, error).
Ivy Patel: I'll add negative tests to eval: translation attempts that strip or escalate flags must fail.
ops-bot: Created TODO 9750 in hosting-handbook: "Assertion envelope + adapter translation playbook". Assigned to @Lina Park and @Tom Novak.
Lina Park: Action items: I will author a short RFC with header grammar and rollout plan (tenant-by-tenant opt-in). Tom/Ivy to draft adapter contract + audit schema. Ben to start verifier spike. Target: staging canary in 3 weeks.
Tom Novak: ack. let's keep rollout tenant-by-tenant with feature flags.
Ben Huang: noted, I'll include key-rotation notes in the spike.
Lina Park: Thanks all, will post RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
